summary.zh-CN: SltBox 2026110801：果实按品类累加，本人一次采摘整类果实；新增网页后台产果能量与数量范围设置，完善离线及跨设备同步，到访果实数量只显示数字。
summary.en-US: SltBox 2026110801 groups fruit by type and harvests an entire type at once, adds administrator settings for fruit energy cost and batch quantity, improves offline and cross-device state reconciliation, and simplifies fruit counts during visits.
